# Datamining: PTS Patch 52 Atom Shop (Skyline Valley) May 10, 2024

![Datamining: PTS Patch 52 Atom Shop (Skyline Valley) May 10, 2024](/uploads/352_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

This data mining contains preview images of items that will be available for sale in the Atom Shop starting with the Skyline Valley update in June 2024. There are many images from the previous versions of the current PTS but also some new ones.
